caption: The drawing consists of two simple, black line diagrams on a plain, light tan or beige background. Each diagram is horizontally centered on the page. The top object features a roughly rectangular base with a trapezoidal shape on top and a small vertical line connecting to a shallow, upward-curving arc below it. The lower object is similar but has a more pronounced, wider curve on its top, giving it a concave appearance. Below this, another small vertical line connects to a larger, more deeply curved arc beneath the rectangle. The background has a uniform, light tan coloration with a few small scattered dark spots and faint stains, but there are no additional colors or elements in the composition.
